results.name: Ports unlock on a coastal build and then trade at 3:1 / 2:1
results.evidence:
ports held before build: [4] -> after: [4,3,5]
port 3 special/wheat: 3 roads laid to reach it, declared 2:1, quoted 2:1, charged 2:1, spent 2 got 1, unlocked=true (held before=false)
port 5 generic: 1 roads laid to reach it, declared 3:1, quoted 3:1, charged 3:1, spent 3 got 1, unlocked=true (held before=false)

results.name: Roads follow legal connection rules; illegal placements are rejected
Settlements obey the distance rule and require a connected road
results.evidence:
beside my own settlement #20 -> corner #12 rejected=true
no connected road (#4, distanceOk=true, roadTouching=false) -> rejected=true
legal corner #8 accepted=true, charged {"wood":4,"brick":4,"wheat":3,"wool":3}
its neighbour #7 now rejected=true

results.name: Cities upgrade only the owner's own settlements
results.evidence:
rival settlement #43 -> false (still a settlement)
empty corner #1 -> false
my settlement #20 -> true, now a city, charged {"wheat":4,"ore":6} vs {"wheat":4,"ore":6}
upgrading the same city again -> false; cities=1

results.name: All three development cards work (Knight, Road Building, Victory Point)
